change: Owned whole App streams use the existing source DATA generic QUIC child and its actual source-flight accounting, with immutable child-key/stream-scope pins.

negotiation.requires: Explicit auxiliary records, duplex QUIC and reliable-parallel permission in authenticated parent capabilities, including authenticated resume metadata.
negotiation.compatibility: Stateless-record-only and older peers keep their original App carrier. No stream is moved mid-flight.
negotiation.relay_policy: No purpose/role on child proofs, no preferential relay service and no connection-quota increase; eight children per direction remains the bound.

lifetime: Each App channel has its own bounded neutral response FIFO. Authenticated RX tail drains before a local FIFO End marker retires pins. TX reservation/commit close races preserve that RX tail while the parent remains authorized; retirement invalidates old streams rather than replaying them on replacements.

full_library_tests.scope: After final EOF reservation/commit guard; subsequent changes only fix two equivalent Clippy boolean/let-chain expressions.

checks.functional_scope: Actual QUIC App Open/Data/Close and receipts, primary activity/pressure pacing with byte preservation and independent RPC, legacy carrier, replacement without migration, full RX FIFO tail despite failed TX, scope checks and authenticated capability/resume tamper rejection. The pressure test supplies a real endpoint activity witness; it is not a PCM or perceptual speech test.

timed_media.scope: Original unmodified 360s/1024-kbit pair/group fixtures with synthetic Opus/VP8 and authenticated 512-KiB files. These fixtures use streamless file records; new whole-App stream behavior is verified by separate QUIC tests.
timed_media.candidate: Before final Closed-commit guard and formatting/lint cleanup. Its binary/source archive is retained. Final rebuilt binary has not rerun these media gates; no release qualification claim.
timed_media.causality: One run per variant cannot establish a causal performance improvement or regression.

remaining: Fix excessive group source-coordinator pauses after short peer concealment: at the tail video_policy.audioReserve is true while its audioAdaptation.latest.paused_after is false. GroupCallAudioAdapter.needsSecondaryYield drives GroupCallSourcePriority requestYield, whose pause/quiet policy outlives brief impairment. Preserve real floor/secondary-yield requirements for actual sustained congestion.
